title: UTSIP Kashiwa 2027
institution: The University of Tokyo, Graduate School of Frontier Sciences
about: The University of Tokyo's Graduate School of Frontier Sciences runs UTSIP Kashiwa, a summer research internship in Kashiwa for undergraduates from overseas universities. The application site opens in late November 2026; the deadline is January 13, 2027 at 17:00 Japan time.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: field "Research internship (frontier sciences)" -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

seniority "Undergraduate students from overseas universities" -> objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."

card_alt: Card for UTSIP Kashiwa 2027 at The University of Tokyo, Graduate School of Frontier Sciences, in Kashiwa, Japan; deadline 13 Jan 2027. The photo shows Tokyo Tower in Tokyo, not Kashiwa.
